notes.title: Update: version 1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]1.0.3 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Fixes and Balance[/b]
[olist]
[*] The “Omamori” relic cost was reduced.
[*] The “Tower Scheme” cost was reduced.
[/olist]
[b]New[/b]
[olist]
[*] Added a button in the Shops to refresh the Relic (works once per Shop visit).
[*] Added three new Relics:
[b]Magical Hat: [/b]Whenever you discard a “Wooden Staff”, heal 1 extra HP.
[b]Framed Heart: [/b]Every time you fill up the Special Gauge, heal 2 HP.
[b]Thorn Shield:[/b] Whenever an enemy misses an attack it takes 1 damage.
[*] Bosses now have effects! Fight them to see what they are capable of now!
[/olist]
[b]Misc[/b]
[olist]
[*] The item “Blade Oil” will no longer appear on Chests.
[*] The “Thief’s Belt” relic is now exclusive to the Rogue and its effect was updated to: Floor Start: if you have no cards in hand create a 'Dagger' Card in hand. If your hand is full, heal 1 HP.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update: version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Version 1.0.2 ends the Halloween event.

[b]1.0.2 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Fixes and Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug on the item card “Key” which allowed it to be used even with 0 AP.
[*] Now the "Blade Oil" item card will give +1 ATK to all Axes variants.
[*] The requirements for some Steam Achievements were adjusted.
[*] The requirements to unlock some heroes were adjusted.
[*] The requirements to unlock some hero’s card borders were adjusted.[/list]
[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*] A new difficulty mode was added: “Insane”.
[*] Two new Steam Achievements were added, both related to the new difficulty mode.
[*] Now some stats of your run will be displayed on the game over screen and when you finish the game.[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] A few spider webs from the Halloween event will stay where they are, for now.[/list]

notes.title: Update: version 1.0.1
notes.content:
A new option was added to the Main Menu - "Time Score":

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8eHqweQ.png[/img]

In this new screen you will be able to check and compare the best times you made with every Hero, in every difficulty.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/u0o6WJL.png[/img]

Take a screen capture and share your best times in the Community Central!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
> Small bug fixes on a few text aligments.
> Now your best time with each Hero will be saved and displayed on the Hero's selection screen.
